parent_objective: run one bounded lower-boundary retune of the rejected-branch retention objective
blocked_by: M949 has no overlap between exact low-tail candidate and M267/M264 preflight

public_gates: M951 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M951 may train only actor_mean and response_context_fusion.0
M951 must use lower boundary train alphas
M951 must evaluate exact metrics and M267/M264 preflight
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run another local coefficient tweak after M951 without synthesis
do not open encoders or GRU
do not run PPO or promotion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_replay: bounded retune of rejected-branch retention near the exact/preflight boundary
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether lower train alphas and adjusted rejected-branch coefficients can create exact/preflight overlap
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective/preflight only; no full replay unless a candidate exists, no private holdout, no PPO, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if exact/preflight overlap still does not exist
fallback_plan: if no candidate exists, route to branch synthesis or rejected-branch trajectory target export
if a candidate exists, route to full replay gate design
if implementation is invalid, route to tooling audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M950 admits exactly one bounded lower-boundary retune after M949 objective conflict

hypothesis: Training the rejected-branch retention objective at lower boundary alphas may create overlap between exact low-tail compatibility and M267/M264 preflight.
success_criteria: exact metrics and M267 preflight are evaluated
failure_criteria: a second local retune is recommended without synthesis

commands.name: run_retune_probe
commands.command: Expose rejected-branch loss coefficients if needed, run one lower-boundary objective-only retune, and write the result.

decision_rule: M951 is the only allowed local retune after M949. It must not run PPO or promote; failure routes to synthesis or trajectory-target export.
